title: Human Anatomy and Physiology II: Main Exam, 10 December 2018
programme: Bachelor of Science in Health Records / Dental Science
instructions: SECTION I: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS. EACH QUESTION CARRIES 6 MARKS. SECTION II: ANSWER ONE QUESTION. EACH QUESTION CARRIES 22 MARKS.

items.text: Section A Short answer questions (6 marks each)
List the functions of the skeletal system.
Name three areas of the body where lymph nodes aggregate and list the functions of the lymphatic system.
Name the lobes of the pituitary gland, indicating the hormones they produce.
Draw a well-labelled diagram of the stomach and name its functions.
Name the parts of the male urethra and explain why cystitis is more common in females than in males.
Give one function of each of the following cranial nerves: optic, oculomotor, glossopharyngeal, facial, olfactory, trigeminal.
Give three functions of muscles and name the three types of body muscles.
Name the cells of the nervous system and state one function of each.
Section B Essay questions (answer one question, 22 marks)
Discuss the nervous system under the following headings.

parts.text: Draw a labelled diagram of a multipolar neuron.
Name three functions of the nervous system.
Explain how an activated sympathetic nervous system affects other body systems.

items.text: Discuss the lymphatic system under the following headings.

parts.text: Name five areas of the body where lymph nodes aggregate.
List the functions of the lymphatic system.
Outline the flow of lymph from the hand to the right atrium.

programmes: Diploma in Health Records and Information Technology
